subject: POC bridge plan & activation cadence (API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, VPC peering)
messages:
From: Alex Martin <alex.martin@bridgeworks.com>
To: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC activation: aligning on network & keys

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to move the POC into our staging cluster the week of July 7th — before we sign. To get there we need to align on: org setup (service account vs org-level API key), short-lived API keys for developers, IP allowlist and a VPC peering window.

Can you confirm Redwood's preferred sequence and any pre-reqs from our side so I can book time with our infra folks? Also, who at Redwood will own the peering configuration and the IP allowlist verification?

Attached: none for now — I can share our internal firewall windows if helpful.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Martin
Head of Platform Engineering, BridgeWorks
alex.martin@bridgeworks.com
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martin <alex.martin@bridgeworks.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com, hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC activation: aligning on network & keys

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear list. Proposed bridge plan + cadence below (high level) to hit July 7th kickoff:

1) Org & identity (Day 0-1):
   - We create a customer org in Redwood and invite your SRE lead as an admin.
   - Recommendation: use org-scoped API keys for staging plus scoped short-lived keys for devs (we'll provide an SDK helper for rotation).

2) API keys & secrets (Day 1-2):
   - We'll issue two artifacts: org-admin API key (long-lived, rotated quarterly) and a dev key template (short TTL via our token service).

3) IP allowlist (Day 2-3):
   - Share your egress IP ranges and we'll provision the allowlist. Please also provide the egress window(s) for your test agents.

4) VPC peering (Day 3-5):
   - Vanessa will own the peering request from Redwood side; we'll use the attached vpc-peering-template.txt for required fields. Typical peering turnaround is 24–48h once both sides accept routing configs.

5) Validation & smoke (Day 5-6):
   - Quick smoke tests (token auth, simple generation calls, latency check). If all green, we flip the test tags and start production-like load testing.

I attached a compact checklist you can import to your tracker (poc-bridgeplan-checklist.xlsx). If this cadence looks good, Vanessa will schedule the peering slot and Hannah will own the API key issuance.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Attachment stubs: poc-bridgeplan-checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), vpc-peering-template.txt (text/plain)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Cc: hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com, Alex Martin <alex.martin@bridgeworks.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC activation: aligning on network & keys

Looping in infra/peering owner and confirming Redwood-side workstream: 

- I'll submit the VPC peering request today once Alex confirms the peer CIDR and routing tag. Expect a confirmation within 24–72 hours depending on their cloud provider.
- We prefer to complete org setup first (invite SRE admin) so that API key rotation can be tested against a scoped account rather than a single token.
- Hannah, please prepare the short-lived key template and the instructions for rotating tokens in CI/CD (Irene: please confirm whether BridgeWorks wants the template as a JSON snippet or a Terraform snippet).

Alex: if you can share two items by EOD tomorrow it will keep us on track for the July 7th start: 1) peer CIDR(s) and desired peering window; 2) egress IPs for allowlist. If you need Redwood to open the peering request form for your network team, say the word and I'll send the DocuSign link for authorization.

Vanessa
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Martin <alex.martin@bridgeworks.com>
To: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com, hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 02 Jul 2025 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC activation: aligning on network & keys

Thanks — this looks good and aligned with our internal timeline. Quick answers:

- Peer CIDR: 10.40.0.0/16 (we'll restrict to subnets during peering).
- Egress IPs: 52.12.34.56, 52.12.34.57 (we'll provide a full list by EOD Thu).
- Peering window: prefer July 8 10:00–12:00 PDT, with a fallback on July 9 morning.
- Template format: Terraform is ideal for our infra runbook.

Please go ahead and create the org invite and the DocuSign peering authorization. We'll route the authorization to our procurement team once we have the DocuSign.

Appreciate the clear checklist — I imported the stub and added internal owners. Let's confirm a final kickoff calendar invite once the peering is scheduled.

Alex
